records.source: The settings file is the one the GUI writes. records.translation: El archivo de ajustes es el que escribe la GUI. Se leen ambos formatos CSV de spaCR, ``Key,Value`` (lo que :func:`spacr.utils.save_settings` emite junto a cada ejecución) y ``setting_key,setting_value`` (el valor por defecto documentado de :func:`spacr.utils.load_settings`), además del ``settings.json`` escrito en cada carpeta del diario de ejecución. records.context: With no arguments it fetches the example sets -- Import, Mask, Measure, Annotate/Classify, Replication, Recruitment and the synthetic Invasion set -- which come to about 1.8 GB. The OPS and Align & Stitch samples are fetched only when named (``spacr-download ops stitch``) or with ``all``. It does not fetch the published TSG101 screen, which is 33 GB. The screen is opt-in, is asked for in pieces, and is confirmed before it starts. The pieces are :mod:`spacr.screen_data`'s, unchanged: four measurement databases of about 0.5 GB and four extracted image region folders of about 8 GB, any subset of which can be named.

records.source: With no arguments it fetches the example sets -- Import, Mask, Measure, Annotate/Classify, Replication, Recruitment and the synthetic Invasion set -- which come to about 1.8 GB. The OPS and Align & Stitch samples are fetched only when named (``spacr-download ops stitch``) or with ``all``. It does not fetch the published TSG101 screen, which is 33 GB. The screen is opt-in, is asked for in pieces, and is confirmed before it starts. The pieces are :mod:`spacr.screen_data`'s, unchanged: four measurement databases of about 0.5 GB and four crop folders of about 8 GB, any subset of which can be named.
records.translation: Sin argumentos, obtiene los conjuntos de ejemplo (Import, Mask, Measure, Annotate/Classify, Replication, Recruitment y el conjunto sintético Invasion), que suman unos 1.8 GB. Las muestras de OPS y de Align & Stitch solo se obtienen cuando se nombran (``spacr-download ops stitch``) o con ``all``. No obtiene el cribado TSG101 publicado, que ocupa 33 GB. El cribado es opcional, se solicita por partes y se confirma antes de empezar. Las partes son las de :mod:`spacr.screen_data`, sin cambios: cuatro bases de datos de mediciones de unos 0.5 GB y cuatro carpetas de recortes de unos 8 GB, de las que puede nombrarse cualquier subconjunto.

records.source: Every plate's measurements archive unpacks to ``measurements/measurements.db`` and every plate's crop archive unpacks to ``data/`` -- the same two paths, four times over. Unpacked into one folder the fourth plate would silently overwrite the third, and :meth:`spacr.screen_data.ScreenAsset.is_present` would report a plate as downloaded because a different plate's file is sitting where its own would go. The plate number is therefore part of the path, and each plate folder can be opened on its own.
records.translation: El archivo comprimido de mediciones de cada placa se descomprime en ``measurements/measurements.db`` y el de recortes de cada placa en ``data/``: las mismas dos rutas, cuatro veces. Descomprimidas en una sola carpeta, la cuarta placa sobrescribiría en silencio la tercera, y :meth:`spacr.screen_data.ScreenAsset.is_present` notificaría una placa como descargada porque el archivo de otra placa ocupa el lugar del suyo. Por ello, el número de placa forma parte de la ruta, y cada carpeta de placa puede abrirse por separado.

records.source: spaCR uses one SQLite database as the meeting point for Measure worker processes, the annotator writer thread, read-only GUI queries, run-status stamps, and schema migrations.  This module provides the rules those paths share:
records.translation: spaCR usa una única base de datos SQLite como punto de encuentro de los procesos de trabajo de Measure, el hilo escritor del anotador, las consultas de solo lectura de la GUI, las marcas de estado de ejecución y las migraciones del esquema. records.source: This addresses issue #15 ("measurements sometimes hangs"). Measure runs one worker per field and every append goes through pandas' ``DataFrame.to_sql``, which issues a ``has_table`` probe -- a read -- before writing. So each worker alternates read, write, read, write against one file.
records.translation: Esto resuelve la incidencia #15 ("measurements sometimes hangs"). Measure ejecuta un proceso de trabajo por campo de imagen y cada adición pasa por ``DataFrame.to_sql`` de pandas, que emite una comprobación ``has_table`` (una lectura) antes de escribir. Así, cada proceso de trabajo alterna lectura, escritura, lectura, escritura sobre un mismo archivo.

records.context: Under the shipped rollback journal that combination starves the writer. A reader holds SHARED for the length of its statement, and a writer cannot COMMIT until every SHARED lock is gone, so with enough workers there is almost always someone reading and the committing worker waits out its busy timeout and raises "database is locked" -- usually surfacing on the next process's ``has_table``, which is the statement in the reporter's traceback.
records.label: spacr.database_concurrency.enable_wal_where_safe#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Under the shipped rollback journal that combination starves the writer. A reader holds SHARED for the length of its statement, and a writer cannot COMMIT until every SHARED lock is gone, so with enough workers there is almost always someone reading and the committing worker waits out its busy timeout and raises "database is locked" -- usually surfacing on the next process's ``has_table``, which is the statement in the reporter's traceback.
records.translation: Con el diario de reversión incluido por defecto, esa combinación deja sin acceso al escritor. Un lector mantiene SHARED durante toda su sentencia, y un escritor no puede hacer COMMIT hasta que desaparezcan todos los bloqueos SHARED, de modo que con suficientes procesos de trabajo casi siempre hay alguien leyendo, y el proceso que confirma agota su tiempo de espera por ocupación y genera "database is locked", que suele aparecer en el ``has_table`` del siguiente proceso, que es la sentencia de la traza de pila de quien lo notificó.

records.context: scratch database to create. It must not already exist (:exc:`FileExistsError`); missing parent directories are created, and a processing session that FINISHES leaves the file on disk along with any ``-wal`` and ``-shm`` sidecars, so every explicit run needs a fresh path. Omit it to probe a temporary database instead, which is removed after a clean finish. A processing session that RAISES -- a ``journal_mode`` :func:`connect` refuses, most often -- removes its scratch database either way: it never ran, so there is nothing in it to keep, and leaving one at an explicit path made the next run on it fail with :exc:`FileExistsError`. The one deliberate survivor is a worker that outlives the 30-second join deadline, whose database is kept for inspection.

records.source: `spacr.hits.gene_of` reads a regression design term -- `fraction:grna[225160_1]` -- and truncates at the first underscore. Applied to the bare `TGGT1_225160_2` that a count table carries, that rule returns `TGGT1`, the organism, for every guide in the screen. Only a bracketed term is therefore passed to `hits.gene_of`.
records.translation: `spacr.hits.gene_of` lee un término de diseño de la regresión (`fraction:grna[225160_1]`) y trunca en el primer guion bajo. This works for `PF3D7_0100100_1` and for a human library without listing either organism.

records.translation: Un nombre simple se analiza según su número de partes separadas por guiones bajos. `process_reads` divide `<organism>_<gene>_<guide>` en exactamente tres componentes, de modo que el gen de un nombre con tres o más partes es la parte o partes centrales, y el gen de un nombre de dos partes es la primera. records.translation: El eje x usa los pocillos efectivos en lugar de `share`. `share` es la fracción mediana que ocupa un gen en los pocillos en los que está presente, de modo que un gen raro puede obtener una puntuación alta en ella. En los datos de prueba de este módulo, un gen presente en 18 de 120 pocillos tiene un share de 0.44 y uno presente en los 120 tiene 0.20, lo contrario de su potencia estadística. La razón de participación es la magnitud que usó la prueba.

records.context: This reads the grid along its measurement axis. records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_sweep.plot_measurement_hits#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: This reads the grid along its measurement axis. A measurement moved by half the library does not discriminate between genes; it more likely reflects a plate effect, focus drift or confluence artefact, and it adds a hit to many genes. Measurements moved by at least half of the significant genes are ringed.
records.translation: Esto lee la cuadrícula a lo largo de su eje de mediciones. Una medición que mueve la mitad de la biblioteca no discrimina entre genes; es más probable que refleje un efecto de placa, una deriva del enfoque o un artefacto de confluencia, y añade un acierto a muchos genes. Las mediciones movidas por al menos la mitad de los genes significativos se rodean con un anillo.

records.translation: La cuadrícula completa es demasiado grande para leerse como imagen: 1,240 guías x 767 mediciones son 951,080 celdas, todas coloreadas sean o no significativas. Por ello, el mapa de calor solo dibuja los supervivientes (las guías y mediciones con al menos una entrada que supera la corrección) y ordena filas y columnas mediante agrupamiento por correlación.

records.context: The implementation evaluates the profiled REML deviance from Bates et al. (2015, equation 41):
records.label: spacr.mixed_gpu#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The implementation evaluates the profiled REML deviance from Bates et al. (2015, equation 41):
records.translation: La implementación evalúa la desviación REML perfilada de Bates et al. (2015, ecuación 41):

records.context: d(theta) = log|Lambda' Z'Z Lambda + I| + log|X' W^-1 X| + (n - p) [1 + log(2 pi r^2 / (n - p))]
records.label: spacr.mixed_gpu#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: d(theta) = log|Lambda' Z'Z Lambda + I| + log|X' W^-1 X| + (n - p) [1 + log(2 pi r^2 / (n - p))]
records.translation: d(theta) = log|Lambda' Z'Z Lambda + I| + log|X' W^-1 X| + (n - p) [1 + log(2 pi r^2 / (n - p))]

records.context: Here ``Lambda = diag(sqrt(theta))``, ``W = I + Z Lambda^2 Z'``, and ``r^2`` is the minimized penalized residual sum of squares. Device-side cross-products ``Z'Z``, ``Z'X``, ``Z'y``, ``X'X``, ``X'y``, and ``y'y`` are computed once. Each optimizer evaluation then requires a ``q x q`` Cholesky factorization and triangular solves. Autograd differentiates the deviance and L-BFGS optimizes ``log(theta)``, which enforces positive variance ratios.
records.label: spacr.mixed_gpu#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Here ``Lambda = diag(sqrt(theta))``, ``W = I + Z Lambda^2 Z'``, and ``r^2`` is the minimized penalized residual sum of squares. Device-side cross-products ``Z'Z``, ``Z'X``, ``Z'y``, ``X'X``, ``X'y``, and ``y'y`` are computed once. Each optimizer evaluation then requires a ``q x q`` Cholesky factorization and triangular solves. Autograd differentiates the deviance and L-BFGS optimizes ``log(theta)``, which enforces positive variance ratios.
records.translation: Aquí, ``Lambda = diag(sqrt(theta))``, ``W = I + Z Lambda^2 Z'`` y ``r^2`` es la suma de cuadrados de los residuos penalizada minimizada. Los productos cruzados ``Z'Z``, ``Z'X``, ``Z'y``, ``X'X``, ``X'y`` y ``y'y`` se calculan una vez en el dispositivo. Después, cada evaluación del optimizador requiere una factorización de Cholesky ``q x q`` y resoluciones triangulares. Autograd diferencia la desviación y L-BFGS optimiza ``log(theta)``, lo que garantiza razones de varianza positivas.

records.context: Reference measurements explain where acceleration is expected. Statsmodels ``MixedLM`` took 54 times as long as OLS on a 40-gene screening experiment and 67 times as long on an 80-gene screening experiment. At ``q = 1212``, the Cholesky step took 204 ms on the CPU and 7.69 ms on an RTX 3090. For a design with 1,830 observations, 387 genes, 710 guides, 388 fixed effects, and 1,097 random levels, end-to-end times were 11.3 s for statsmodels, 0.80 s for this backend on CPU, and 0.47 s on the RTX 3090. Use :func:`benchmark_against_statsmodels` to measure the supported backends on another design and device.
records.label: spacr.mixed_gpu#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Reference measurements explain where acceleration is expected. Statsmodels ``MixedLM`` took 54 times as long as OLS on a 40-gene screen and 67 times as long on an 80-gene screen. For a design with 1,830 observations, 387 genes, 710 guides, 388 fixed effects, and 1,097 random levels, end-to-end times were 11.3 s for statsmodels, 0.80 s for this backend on CPU, and 0.47 s on the RTX 3090. records.translation: Las mediciones de referencia explican dónde cabe esperar aceleración. ``MixedLM`` de Statsmodels tardó 54 veces más que OLS en un cribado de 40 genes y 67 veces más en uno de 80 genes. Con ``q = 1212``, el paso de Cholesky tardó 204 ms en la CPU y 7.69 ms en una RTX 3090. Para un diseño con 1,830 observaciones, 387 genes, 710 guías, 388 efectos fijos y 1,097 niveles aleatorios, los tiempos de principio a fin fueron 11.3 s para statsmodels, 0.80 s para este motor en CPU y 0.47 s en la RTX 3090. Use :func:`benchmark_against_statsmodels` para medir los motores admitidos en otro diseño y dispositivo.

records.context: A pooled screening experiment has no single correct analysis. It has a model family, an aggregation rule, a unit of analysis, a set of nuisance effects, a multiple-testing correction, and three or four filtration cutoffs -- and a hit list that is stable across all of them is a very different claim from one that appears under exactly one combination.
records.label: spacr.parameter_sweep#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A pooled screen has no single correct analysis. It has a model family, an aggregation rule, a unit of analysis, a set of nuisance effects, a multiple-testing correction, and three or four filtration cutoffs -- and a hit list that is stable across all of them is a very different claim from one that appears under exactly one combination.
records.translation: Un cribado agrupado no tiene un único análisis correcto. Tiene una familia de modelos, una regla de agregación, una unidad de análisis, un conjunto de efectos de confusión, una corrección por pruebas múltiples y tres o cuatro umbrales de filtrado, y una lista de aciertos estable en todos ellos es una afirmación muy distinta de otra que solo aparece con una combinación concreta.

records.context: This module executes that comparison as one command. It builds a trial list from a search space, runs each trial into its own folder, and returns one tidy row per trial: the settings, whether it ran, how many microplate sample positions and guides survived, how many hits it called, where the named controls landed, and how long it took.
records.label: spacr.parameter_sweep#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: This module runs that comparison as one command. It builds a trial list from a search space, runs each trial into its own folder, and returns one tidy row per trial: the settings, whether it ran, how many wells and guides survived, how many hits it called, where the named controls landed, and how long it took.
records.translation: Este módulo ejecuta esa comparación con un solo comando. Construye una lista de ensayos a partir de un espacio de búsqueda, ejecuta cada ensayo en su propia carpeta y devuelve una fila ordenada por ensayo: los ajustes, si se ejecutó, cuántos pocillos y guías se conservaron, cuántos aciertos identificó, dónde quedaron los controles con nombre y cuánto tardó.

records.context: Two design choices keep a sweep practical:
records.label: spacr.parameter_sweep#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Two design choices keep a sweep practical:
records.translation: Dos decisiones de diseño hacen práctico un barrido:

records.context: **Preparation is shared.** Loading 226k score rows and 642k count rows, aggregating per microplate sample position, thresholding and joining costs about twenty seconds and depends only on the filtration settings. Every trial sharing those reuses one prepared frame, so a sweep over models and corrections pays that cost once per filtration cell rather than once per trial.
records.label: spacr.parameter_sweep#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Preparation is shared.** Loading 226k score rows and 642k count rows, aggregating per well, thresholding and joining costs about twenty seconds and depends only on the filtration settings. Every trial sharing those reuses one prepared frame, so a sweep over models and corrections pays that cost once per filtration cell rather than once per trial.
records.translation: **La preparación se comparte.** Cargar 226k filas de puntuaciones y 642k filas de recuentos, agregar por pocillo, aplicar umbrales y unir cuesta unos veinte segundos y solo depende de los ajustes de filtrado. Todos los ensayos que los comparten reutilizan una única tabla preparada, de modo que un barrido sobre modelos y correcciones paga ese coste una vez por combinación de filtrado y no una vez por ensayo.

records.context: **A failed trial is a result.** Many combinations are illegal by construction -- ``quantile`` refuses ``alpha``, the penalised families refuse ``cov_type``, ``random_row_column_effects`` replaces the backend entirely. Those are recorded with their reason and the sweep continues, because "this combination is not allowed" is information about the design space, not a crash.

records.source: **A failed trial is a result.** Many combinations are illegal by construction -- ``quantile`` refuses ``alpha``, the penalised families refuse ``cov_type``, ``random_row_column_effects`` replaces the backend entirely. Those are recorded with their reason and the sweep continues, because "this combination is not allowed" is information about the design space, not a crash.
records.translation: **Un ensayo fallido es un resultado.** Muchas combinaciones son ilegales por construcción: ``quantile`` rechaza ``alpha``, las familias penalizadas rechazan ``cov_type`` y ``random_row_column_effects`` reemplaza el motor por completo. Se registran con su motivo y el barrido continúa, porque "this combination is not allowed" es información sobre el espacio de diseño, no un fallo.

records.context: Python's :mod:`sqlite3` opens an implicit transaction for DML only, so an ``ALTER TABLE`` runs in autocommit and lands immediately --- the same trap :func:`spacr.utils.rename_columns_in_db` was fixed for. records.context: Why an ROI is stored in world coordinates
records.label: spacr.roi#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Why an ROI is stored in world coordinates
records.translation: Por qué una ROI se almacena en coordenadas del mundo

records.context: A polygon drawn on a 512-pixel preview of a 2048-pixel field is not the same set of array indices as the region it names. Storing ``(row, column)`` would make the ROI mean four different things at four zoom levels, and the picture would look right in every one of them. So a saved ROI is a list of world points plus the unit they are measured in, and placing it on a mask goes through :class:`~spacr.layers.Spacing` and :meth:`~spacr.layers.Canvas.for_grid` exactly like every other render in this codebase. Mixing a µm ROI with a pixel-spaced measurement raises rather than drawing a plausible region in the wrong place.
records.label: spacr.roi#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A polygon drawn on a 512-pixel preview of a 2048-pixel field is not the same set of array indices as the region it names. Storing ``(row, column)`` would make the ROI mean four different things at four zoom levels, and the picture would look right in every one of them. So a saved ROI is a list of world points plus the unit they are measured in, and placing it on a mask goes through :class:`~spacr.layers.Spacing` and :meth:`~spacr.layers.Canvas.for_grid` exactly like every other render in this codebase. Mixing a µm ROI with a pixel-spaced measurement raises rather than drawing a plausible region in the wrong place.
records.translation: Un polígono dibujado en una vista previa de 512 píxeles de un campo de imagen de 2048 píxeles no es el mismo conjunto de índices de matriz que la región que designa. Almacenar ``(row, column)`` haría que la ROI significara cuatro cosas distintas con cuatro niveles de zoom, y la imagen parecería correcta en todos ellos. Por ello, una ROI guardada es una lista de puntos del mundo más la unidad en la que se miden, y su colocación sobre una máscara pasa por :class:`~spacr.layers.Spacing` y :meth:`~spacr.layers.Canvas.for_grid`, exactamente igual que cualquier otra representación de este código. Mezclar una ROI en µm con una medición con espaciado en píxeles genera una excepción en lugar de dibujar una región plausible en el lugar equivocado.

records.context: ``mode='centroid'`` (the default) keeps an object when its centroid falls inside the ROI. It is the rule that partitions cleanly: an object is inside exactly one of two ROIs that share an edge, so an object on a boundary is counted once, and every object type is judged the same way without the cell and its nucleus ever disagreeing.

records.context: Reaching the workers
records.label: spacr.roi#8

records.source: Reaching the workers
records.translation: Cómo llegar a los procesos de trabajo

records.context: :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop` measures microscope fields of view in a process pool. Under ``spawn`` (Windows, macOS, ``SPACR_START_METHOD=spawn``, and Python 3.14 on Linux) a worker is a fresh interpreter with an empty hook registry: a filter registered with :func:`~spacr.measure_hooks.register_region_filter_hook` in the parent applies to **nothing at all**, the processing session completes, and every object in the microscope field of view is measured while the user believes only the ROI was. That is a silent scientific error, so this module refuses to rely on inheritance: :func:`enable_roi_filter` writes the ROI to disk and names ``spacr.roi:install`` in :data:`~spacr.measure_hooks.HOOKS_ENV_VAR`, and each worker installs the filter for itself from the environment it inherits. :func:`worker_delivery_status` answers "will this actually reach the workers?" before the processing session rather than after it.
records.label: spacr.roi#9
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop` measures fields in a process pool. Under ``spawn`` (Windows, macOS, ``SPACR_START_METHOD=spawn``, and Python 3.14 on Linux) a worker is a fresh interpreter with an empty hook registry: a filter registered with :func:`~spacr.measure_hooks.register_region_filter_hook` in the parent applies to **nothing at all**, the run completes, and every object in the field is measured while the user believes only the ROI was. That is a silent scientific error, so this module refuses to rely on inheritance: :func:`enable_roi_filter` writes the ROI to disk and names ``spacr.roi:install`` in :data:`~spacr.measure_hooks.HOOKS_ENV_VAR`, and each worker installs the filter for itself from the environment it inherits. :func:`worker_delivery_status` answers "will this actually reach the workers?" before the run rather than after it.
records.translation: :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop` mide los campos de imagen en un grupo de procesos. Con ``spawn`` (Windows, macOS, ``SPACR_START_METHOD=spawn`` y Python 3.14 en Linux), un proceso de trabajo es un intérprete nuevo con un registro de ganchos vacío: un filtro registrado con :func:`~spacr.measure_hooks.register_region_filter_hook` en el proceso padre no se aplica a **nada en absoluto**, la ejecución termina y se miden todos los objetos del campo mientras el usuario cree que solo se midió la ROI. Es un error científico silencioso, por lo que este módulo se niega a depender de la herencia: :func:`enable_roi_filter` escribe la ROI en el disco y nombra ``spacr.roi:install`` en :data:`~spacr.measure_hooks.HOOKS_ENV_VAR`, y cada proceso de trabajo instala el filtro por sí mismo a partir del entorno que hereda. :func:`worker_delivery_status` responde a "will this actually reach the workers?" antes de la ejecución y no después.

records.source: Every referenced file is recorded with its size, modification time, and SHA-256 digest. ``reference`` mode stores only this inventory; ``copy`` mode also carries files up to the configured per-file limit. A provider can mark an individual artifact for copying regardless of mode or size. Skipped files and copy failures remain visible in the document and restore report.
records.translation: Cada archivo referenciado se registra con su tamaño, su hora de modificación y su resumen SHA-256.
